title: Is it safe to run SearXNG publicly without the limiter? Give evidence.

data.query: Is it safe to run SearXNG publicly without the limiter? Give evidence.
data.answer:
PEP 703 proposes adding a build configuration (--disable-gil) to CPython so that it can run Python code without the global interpreter lock. [1]

### Details
- The limiter is SearXNG's bot protection. [2]
- Public instances should run it, because engines such as Google and Bing block instances that send automated traffic. [2]
- Without the limiter, a public instance can be abused and get its IP address banned by upstream search engines. [3]
- The limiter protects public instances from bots; it should be enabled on any instance reachable from the internet. [4]

### Findings
- PEP 703 proposes adding a build configuration (--disable-gil) to CPython so that it can run Python code without the global interpreter lock. [1]

- Public instances should run it, because engines such as Google and Bing block instances that send automated traffic. [2]
